title: IP snowshoeing under US .gov email via a whitelisted AmazonSES typo in SPF
content_md:
I run a small email security consultancy and this is our research. A typo of AmazonSES in US government DNS whitelisted 32,066 IPs to pass DMARC p=quarantine as milivcounty[.]gov, with the IP set rotating every 3-8 days. Attackers are snowshoeing the IPs, and once they get listed by Abusix and Spamhaus, they rotate the SPF include chain. Other AmazonSES typos in gov SPF are amasonses[.]com under pikevilleky[.]gov and amazones[.]com under townofkirkwood[.]gov. There are also 40 other US Gov domains with dangling & abused NS (domain takeover), MX (mail interception), and DMARC (telemetry hijack) records.
